meta.author: Khaled Mahmud
meta.tagline: Four hands-on tools for learning, analyzing, and building music — pick a unit below to get started.

units.title: Note Bench
units.description: Analyze the notes of real instruments in both the time and frequency domain — see the waveform and the spectrum behind every pitch.

units.title: Instrument Bench
units.description: Build custom tones from scratch — shape harmonics, play them on a keyboard, and hear exactly how additive synthesis works.

units.title: Taal Bench
units.description: Learn the basics of tabla and taal — the rhythmic cycles at the heart of Indian classical music.

units.title: Music Theory Book
units.description: A fully interactive music theory course — click a keyboard, build a chord, or play through a progression instead of just reading about it.
